entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello. Yes, I'm... I'm a bit confused. I bought a jersey and it doesn't fit, and I'm not sure what to do. The website was a little overwhelming.
I can certainly help you with that. To start, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's not broken. I just... I think I ordered the wrong size. It feels way too tight across the shoulders. I was hoping I could do an exchange, but I couldn't figure it out.
I completely understand, getting the right fit is crucial. Let me just pull up your order. Can I get your name or order number?
Yes, the order number is VF55802. It was for the ClubFit Jersey.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. You received it 33 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy.
Oh no, is that too long? I'm sorry, I'm just so bad with this stuff. Can't you just help me?
No worries at all. I've just checked, and for our standard apparel like this jersey, you have a 90-day return window. So you are well within the timeframe for an exchange.
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. So I can swap it for a different size?
Absolutely. I can process that for you right now. I'll email you a prepaid return label for the jersey that's too tight, and we can get the correct size sent out to you. What size did you need?
A Large would be perfect. Thank you so much, Isaac. You've made this so easy.

You're very welcome. I've put through the exchange for a Large. The email with your return label is on its way. Just mail the wrong size jersey back, and we'll ship the new one. Is there anything else I can assist with?
Happy to help. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
